nodes.label: ArticleDAO Pattern
nodes.rationale: Thread-safe value type representing managed objects. Sendable, immutable, and explicit data transfer. Avoids passing NSManagedObject across isolation domains.

nodes.label: CoreDataStore Pattern
nodes.rationale: Enforces isolation at API level: @MainActor for view context, @concurrent for background. Simple alternative to custom executor.

nodes.label: NSManagedObjectContextExecutor
nodes.rationale: Custom SerialExecutor wrapping NSManagedObjectContext. Advanced pattern, usually not needed; adds hidden complexity.

nodes.label: async_without_await SwiftLint Rule
nodes.rationale: Never fix by inserting fake suspension. Diagnose why the declaration is async; prefer removing async or narrowly suppressing.

nodes.label: Retain Cycles with Tasks
nodes.rationale: Tasks capture self strongly. When self owns the task and the task captures self, neither can be deallocated.

nodes.label: Migration to Swift 6 and Strict Concurrency
nodes.norm_label: migration to swift 6 and strict concurrency

nodes.label: Concurrency Rabbit Hole
nodes.rationale: Fixing isolation in one place exposes issues elsewhere. Manageable with incremental strategy: Minimal -> Targeted -> Complete checking.

nodes.label: Actor Contention
nodes.rationale: Tasks waiting on a busy actor cause unnecessary suspensions. Remove actor when no shared mutable state; use @concurrent for parallelism.

nodes.label: Data Race vs Race Condition
nodes.rationale: Swift Concurrency prevents data races but not race conditions. Actors serialize access; Sendable ensures type-level safety. Race conditions require correct sequencing by the developer.

nodes.label: withMainSerialExecutor (ConcurrencyExtras)
nodes.rationale: Controls task scheduling in tests to make flaky race-condition tests deterministic. Requires serial test execution.

nodes.label: Isolation Mindset (vs Threading Mindset)
nodes.rationale: Stop asking 'what thread?' and ask 'what isolation domain?'. @MainActor for UI, custom actors for state, nonisolated for general work. Provide hints not commands.

nodes.label: SE-461 Nonisolated Async Functions Inherit Isolation
nodes.norm_label: se-461 nonisolated async functions inherit isolation

nodes.label: DragState Enum
nodes.rationale: State machine for mouse interaction: idle, draggingNewSelection, resizingLeft, resizingRight. Drives all selection geometry — no layout in mouse handlers.

nodes.label: Selection Layer Stack
nodes.rationale: 6 CALayers overlay waveform bitmap without re-rendering it: leftDimLayer(z20), rightDimLayer(z21), selectionBorderLayer(z22), leftHandleLayer(z23), rightHandleLayer(z24), durationBadgeLayer(z25).
